concerns.text: T007 is marked [ ] (incomplete) but defines the JSON schema contracts for `dynamic_shift_env`, `counterfactual_explanation`, and `evolution_metrics`. Spec FR-002 and FR-005 explicitly require schema validation and mixed-effects modeling based on these structures. Without T007, the validation logic in T020b and T036 has no contract to enforce, violating the 'Verified Accuracy' and 'Data Hygiene' constitution principles.

T023 (fallback mechanism) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Spec FR-006 and Constitution Principle VI mandate a fallback to template-based explanations if the LLM fails/times out to prevent pipeline crashes. T023 is the only task addressing this; its absence means the system cannot handle LLM failures as required, violating FR-006.

T036 (mixed-effects model) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Spec FR-005 requires a mixed-effects model accounting for 'nested runs within seeds'. T036 is the sole task implementing this statistical analysis. Without it, the system cannot compare generalization scores as mandated by FR-005 and SC-003.

T037 (CLI entry point) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Spec FR-003 requires executing the evolutionary harness on both conditions. T037 is the only task providing the CLI entry point (`python main.py --run-evolution`) to orchestrate this. Without it, the full pipeline cannot be executed as a single unit, violating FR-003.

T015 (sensitivity report) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Spec US-1 requires verifying that the shift causes a measurable performance drop. T015 generates the `sensitivity_report.csv` to document this. Without it, the independent test for US-1 cannot be fully verified, weakening the acceptance criteria for FR-001.

T038 (Documentation) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle V (Versioning) require documentation (`README.md`, `quickstart.md`) to ensure results are reproducible. T038 is the only task addressing this. Its absence violates the constitution's reproducibility requirements.

T042 (Quickstart validation) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan requires a `quickstart.md` to be validated. T042 is the only task ensuring this validation occurs. Without it, the 'Reproducibility' principle cannot be verified, violating the constitution.
